page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 64 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. With a single thread per core and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance provides predictable compute performance. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

The instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. It offers a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps to support external data transfers and multi-node clustering. The hardware configuration delivers a stable resource density suitable for enterprise applications, web serving, and database hosting where dedicated CPU execution is required without hyperthreading overhead.
